newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: New, small Venezuelan airline to take off in March.
newsitem.headline: New, small Venezuelan airline to take off in March.

text.p: A small Venezuelan airline, Santa Barbara Air Lines, will start operating in March with flights to neighboring Colombia and the Netherlands Antilles' islands of Aruba and Curacao, a government official said.
Pedro Corzo, president of Corpozulia, a state-run body in charge of developing western, oil-rich Zulia state, said the airline will start flying with three mid-sized planes.
Based in Santa Barbara, southern Zulia, it is expected to offer flights throughout Zulia, Corzo told a news conference.
Corpozulia, with a minority stake in the airline, invested 100 million bolivars ($210,000) in association with local businessmen.
